title: Black Death: read the reports
hook: Can dated reports reveal a single precise infection route?

knows: Events happen in places and at different times.

objective: These dots show dated evidence, not a proven chain of infections.

claims.text: 1338–39: Central Asian record. Memorial stones near Issyk-Kul record plague deaths.

recall.question: Do these checkpoints establish every transmission path?
recall.why: These dots show dated evidence, not a proven chain of infections. Central Asian memorials, biological evidence and London’s records illuminate different parts of the pandemic. Historians debate its origins and pathways. A sequence of reports cannot establish who infected whom.
